name: Lexrul
description: Lexrul was a heavily industrialized planet in the Lexrul system in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Orson Callan Krennic was born in Sativran City on the planet around 52 BBY.
lead_paragraphs: Lexrul was a heavily industrialized planet in the Lexrul system in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Orson Callan Krennic was born in Sativran City on the planet around 52 BBY.
